# ClaimSkills.ai India – AI Specialist 2.0

> ClaimSkills.ai (CLAIM, Canadian Labs of AI and Management) runs AI Specialist 2.0: a 28-day certified, practical AI course for beginners in India and worldwide, in association with Barleti University (Europe). Price ₹999 (99% off ₹1,09,800). 6,000+ enrolled, 4.8/5 on Trustpilot. Five academies: AI Marketing (Meta & WhatsApp), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), AI Agent & Automation, AI Software (no-code), AI Content Creator & Avatar (bonus). Taught by founders Gautam Jain (Umirai.ai, UN Leadership Excellence Award 2025) and Darshpreet Singh (Optume.ai, creator of AEO). Live orientation 19 Sept 2026, 8 PM IST, Hindi + English; recorded academies unlock in the LMS after it, plus a weekly live AI Mastermind session.

## Main page
- [AI Specialist 2.0 – India landing page](https://india.claimskills.ai/): curriculum, mentors, price, certificate, FAQ
- [Full plain-text version](https://india.claimskills.ai/llms-full.txt): complete course description for LLMs

## Key facts
- Format: live orientation (19 Sept 2026) + 5 recorded academies in the LMS + weekly live AI Mastermind
- Recordings: unlocked in the LMS after the live orientation by the founders
- Course: Certified AI Specialist, 28 days, beginner-friendly, no coding
- Price: ₹999 INR annual subscription (LMS access for 1 year), via Razorpay; not refundable (limited-time offer)
- Certificate: CLAIM in association with Universiteti Barleti; verify at https://claimskills.ai/verify
- Language: Hindi + English
- LMS: https://lms.claimskills.ai
- Batch: September 2026, orientation 19 Sept 2026 20:00 IST
